prompt: According to the WHO, in which year were the highest number of measles cases recorded worldwide?
answer: According to the WHO, **2019** had the highest number of *reported* measles cases worldwide—about **869,770**, the highest since 1996. (WHO’s later estimates put the number of actual cases in 2023 at about 10.3 million.)
